falsifiable_hypothesis: Patient-count weighting corrects the slight mismatch between equal-fold and equal-patient contrast estimation, while global-vector and common-mode James-Stein reliabilities are complementary evidence channels for confidence in that contrast estimate. Their probabilistic union supplies a bounded parameter-free amplification signal.
component_rule: Orientation A is leave-one-whole-patient bagged geometry. Orientation B starts from interpolated-jackknife geometry. No A/B prediction averaging occurs.
shrinkage_rule: First compute theta_weighted, a_global and a_common exactly as in patient_count_weighted_amplitude_js, using inner-fold whole-patient counts n_k for generalized least-squares means and matching variance-of-mean estimates. Then set confidence_union=1-(1-a_global)*(1-a_common), amplification=1+confidence_union, theta_final=amplification*theta_weighted, and q_B=q_B,interpolated_jackknife-0.5*theta_final. There is no amplification menu, per-target outer routing, held-fold outcome use in the canonical rule, or protected data.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
